classificationReasoning: A real, complete transversal-zigzag column generator exists (generateSatinColumnPath) with width and density parameters — so SATIN_NOT_IMPLEMENTED is false.

It is reachable only through the contour route (obj.isContour === true) and consumes a centreline plus width, not a region boundary — so SATIN_FULLY_IMPLEMENTED is false: there is no verifiable path from a region-level technique classification to column commands.
For region objects, planning and parameters exist (planner classification, satin underlay, satin stitch length, satin compensation) while the generator does not — the definition of partial.

SATIN_LABEL_ONLY was rejected because the pattern is not merely 'the same as fill': a satin-labelled region takes a different branch (polygon path), and a genuine column generator does exist elsewhere in productive code.
